Allahabad University Teaching Online Form 2025 – Full Details

University of Allahabad has released the notification for the post of Professor, Assistant Professor and Associate Professor. This recruitment has been issued for 317 posts. Online applying process for Allahabad University Teaching Recruitment 2025 has started from 11 April 2025 & the candidates can apply till 02 May 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for Allahabad University Teaching Recruitment 2025 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 11 April 2025
  • Last Date : 02 May 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 02 May 2025
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 2000/-
  • SC, ST : Rs. 1000/-
  • All Category PH : Rs. 100/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

  • Apply Online (Registration)
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website
